text:
First thing I've set up with my Grok @bot is Overwatch. 

I want my Bot's VM to be clean, backed up in Git, and constantly improving.

- keeps a live registry of every bot and thinks about how to optimize them
- pushes /workspace to git every workday hour, so entire setup is backed up and portable to any machine or harness
- monitors and auto-cleans Bot folders
- archives one-off files so there is no bloat

Full prompt below 👇
